name: Changchun Zhiyuan New Energy Equipment Co., Ltd
summary: Changchun Zhiyuan New Energy Equipment Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sales of products such as onboard LNG (liquified natural gas) gas supply systems, LNG-powered ship fuel systems, and cryogenic storage tanks in China and internationally. The company also provides processing and sales of graphitized lithium-ion battery anode materials; graphitized carbide; skid-mounted equipment; tank containers; cryogenic liquid storage tanks; marine tanker; inland waterway tankers; onboard high-pressure hydrogen supply system; and single and double chamber aluminum alloy gas storage tanks.
